• Origin: Asia
  • Height: 3 - 5+ cm (average height after two months in the tank)
  • Light demand: Medium
  • CO2: Medium

Hygrophila serpyllum is a unique, compact plant perfect for adding lush green tones and intricate leaf patterns to the aquarium foreground or midground. With its low-growing nature, this plant creates a carpet-like effect that can fill in spaces beautifully, making it an excellent choice for aquascapers who want a dense, textured look. Its bright green leaves bring freshness and contrast, making it ideal for natural-style aquascapes. Easy to care for, it thrives under moderate lighting and can adapt to a wide range of water conditions. Its manageable growth rate allows aquarists to shape it with occasional trimming, keeping it dense and compact.

• Compact growth: ideal for foreground use.
  • Vibrant green colour: adds fresh contrast.
  • Easy maintenance: minimal trimming required.
  • Dense texture: perfect for a carpeted look.
  • Adaptable: thrives in varied conditions.
